node_definition.done_when: Build plan one-typesafe-model-picker §14 exactly as the section states; the section is the authority for its two items and the done-when. First confirm on main that a run promoted inside the 5 s shadow window records no picker_selection on its ledger row, and that route_mode labels an operator-overridden hold as shadow. Make promotion wait for an in-flight shadow pick, up to the pick's own bound, then record the selection or name the timeout. Give the overridden hold its own route_mode value through a named predicate, and make crew pick --outcomes count it apart from shadow picks. Tests go in tests/test_promotion_records_the_pick.py. Gate: that file, tests/test_picker_outcomes.py, every test file that imports reckon.crew.promotion, and every test file that asserts a route_mode value. Run the gate with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 6 in the FOREGROUND, one log each for base and head under the run directory, each opening with a line naming the revision, tree and command and ending in an EXIT= line, judged by delta against the base. Run ruff check and ruff format --check on your changed paths only before committing. Write the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/promotion-records-the-pick.html.
